Michael biopic surpasses Oppenheimer as highest-grossing film of its genre

The biopic 'Michael' has reportedly become the highest-grossing biopic globally, surpassing Christopher Nolan's 'Oppenheimer'. This achievement marks a significant milestone for the film, highlighting its broad audience appeal and commercial success within the genre. The comparison focuses on box office performance.
